title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Central sector scheme providing income support of Rs. 6000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families for agricultural and domestic needs.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land as per land records. Institutional land holders and income tax payers are excluded.
benefits: Rs. 6000 per year direct benefit transfer in three installments of Rs. 2000 each to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance scheme providing comprehensive risk solution to farmers against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest at low premium rates.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Loanee and non-loanee farmers eligible.
benefits: Low premium (2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi, 5% commercial crops) with full sum insured, quick claim settlement and coverage against natural calamities.

title: Kisan Credit Card Scheme
description: Provides farmers timely access to affordable credit for cultivation, post-harvest expenses, consumption and working capital for allied activities.
eligibility: All farmers including small and marginal farmers, sharecroppers, oral lessees, tenant farmers and self-help groups engaged in agriculture.
benefits: Flexible credit up to Rs. 3 lakh at 7% interest with 3% prompt repayment incentive, coverage for crop and allied activities, insurance cover.

title: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Scheme to issue soil health cards to farmers carrying crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers to improve soil fertility and productivity.
eligibility: All farmers across India. Soil samples collected from individual farms are tested in labs and cards distributed.
benefits: Free soil testing and health card with nutrient status and fertilizer recommendations to improve yield and reduce input cost.

title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
description: Merit-based scholarship for meritorious students from low-income families to pursue higher education in colleges and universities.
eligibility: Students who scored above 80th percentile in Class 12, pursuing regular degree, family income below Rs. 4.5 lakh per annum.
benefits: Rs. 12000 per annum for first three years and Rs. 20000 for fourth and fifth year for professional courses via DBT.

title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship to economically weaker students to reduce dropout after Class 8 and encourage continuation of secondary education.
eligibility: Students of Class 9 studying in government or aided schools with parental income below Rs. 3.5 lakh and minimum 55% in Class 8.
benefits: Rs. 12000 per annum (Rs. 1000 per month) for four years from Class 9 to 12 via direct benefit transfer.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
description: Scholarship scheme by AICTE to support meritorious girl students pursuing technical education at diploma and degree levels.
eligibility: Girl students admitted to first year of diploma or degree in AICTE approved institutions with family income below Rs. 8 lakh per annum, maximum two girls per family.
benefits: Rs. 50000 per annum for every year of study covering tuition fees, computer, books and contingency allowance.

title: PM YASASVI Scholarship Scheme
description: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for OBC, EBC and DNT students for pre-matric and post-matric studies.
eligibility: OBC, EBC and DNT students studying in Classes 9 to 12 with parental income below Rs. 2.5 lakh, selected through entrance test.
benefits: Pre-matric Rs. 75000 and post-matric Rs. 125000 per annum including tuition, hostel and other allowances.

title: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization to vulnerable families.
eligibility: Families identified under SECC 2011 database, BPL, low-income, unorganized workers and deprived rural and urban households.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year at empaneled public and private hospitals across India.

title: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana
description: Scheme to provide quality generic medicines at affordable prices through dedicated Janaushadhi Kendras across India.
eligibility: All citizens can purchase generic medicines. Entrepreneurs, NGOs and unemployed pharmacists can apply to open Janaushadhi Kendras.
benefits: Generic medicines at 50-90% lower price than branded medicines, incentives for Kendra owners and employment generation.

title: Janani Suraksha Yojana
description: Safe motherhood intervention promoting institutional delivery among pregnant women to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality.
eligibility: Pregnant women of BPL, SC/ST, low-income rural and urban households. All pregnant women in low performing states.
benefits: Cash assistance Rs. 1400 rural and Rs. 1000 urban plus free delivery, transport and postnatal care at government institutions.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban
description: Housing for All mission providing central assistance to urban poor for construction, enhancement and purchase of pucca houses.
eligibility: EWS, LIG and MIG families without pucca house in urban areas, beneficiary family income criteria and not availed PMAY earlier.
benefits: Subsidy up to Rs. 2.67 lakh under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme, assistance up to Rs. 1.5 lakh for beneficiary-led construction.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Gramin
description: Rural housing scheme providing financial assistance to homeless and those living in kutcha houses to construct pucca houses with basic amenities.
eligibility: Households without pucca house, identified through SECC, Gram Sabha verification, SC/ST, minorities and other deprived rural families.
benefits: Financial assistance Rs. 1.2 lakh in plains and Rs. 1.3 lakh in hilly areas with additional support for toilet and LPG connection.

title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
eligibility: Any adult member of rural household willing to do unskilled manual work. Must be citizen of India and reside in rural area.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days wage employment, unemployment allowance if work not provided, works for asset creation and social security.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: Flagship skill development scheme to enable youth to take up industry-relevant short-term training and secure better livelihoods.
eligibility: Unemployed youth, school or college dropouts, 10th or 12th pass students seeking skill training and certification.
benefits: Free short-term training, skill certification, placement assistance and monetary reward up to Rs. 8000 on successful certification.

title: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
description: Placement-linked skill development for rural poor youth to diversify incomes and cater to career aspirations of rural youth.
eligibility: Rural poor youth aged 15-35 years, from BPL families, SC/ST, women and minority communities with basic education.
benefits: Free residential training, placement in jobs with minimum salary, post-placement support, incentives and career progression.

title: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for generating self-employment through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
eligibility: Any individual above 18 years, self-help groups, charitable trusts. No income ceiling, but special categories get higher subsidy.
benefits: Margin money subsidy 15-35% of project cost up to Rs. 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs. 20 lakh for service sector via banks.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: Scheme to fund unfunded micro and small enterprises by providing collateral-free loans up to Rs. 10 lakh for income generating activities.
eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises including shopkeepers, artisans, vendors and small manufacturers.
benefits: Loans under Shishu (up to 50k), Kishor (50k-5 lakh) and Tarun (5-10 lakh) categories without collateral through banks and MFIs.

title: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore to at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
eligibility: SC/ST and women entrepreneurs above 18 years for greenfield projects in manufacturing, services or trading sector.
benefits: Collateral-free loan Rs. 10 lakh to 1 crore, handholding support, 7 years repayment with 18 months moratorium via all scheduled commercial banks.

title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
description: Financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry and commercialization.
eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startups incorporated not more than 2 years ago, with viable business idea and not received more than Rs. 10 lakh under other schemes.
benefits: Grant up to Rs. 5 lakh for validation and up to Rs. 50 lakh as convertible debenture or debt-linked instruments for growth.

title: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
description: National initiative for survival, protection and education of the girl child to address declining child sex ratio and empower girls.
eligibility: Girl children and their families across India. Focus on districts with low child sex ratio. Awareness and welfare services for all girls.
benefits: Awareness campaigns, education support, prevention of gender-biased sex selection, improved access to education and health services for girls.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small deposit savings scheme for girl child to ensure bright future by encouraging parents to save for education and marriage expenses.
eligibility: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child below 10 years. Maximum two accounts per family, account can be opened at post office or banks.
benefits: High interest rate (8%+ compounded), tax exemption under 80C, maturity after 21 years, partial withdrawal for education after 18 years.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
description: Maternity benefit programme providing partial wage compensation to pregnant and lactating women for first living child.
eligibility: Pregnant and lactating women of 19 years and above for first live birth, working women, excluding government employees.
benefits: Cash incentive Rs. 5000 in three installments directly to bank account for wage loss compensation and nutrition support.

title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: Scheme to provide LPG connections to women from BPL households to safeguard health by reducing indoor air pollution from traditional fuels.
eligibility: Women belonging to BPL households, SECC database, SC/ST, forest dwellers, tea garden workers without LPG connection.
benefits: Free LPG connection, first refill and stove cost, subsidy on subsequent refills, EMI facility for connection cost.

title: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Guaranteed minimum pension scheme for unorganized sector workers to ensure financial security in old age.
eligibility: Citizens aged 18-40 years with bank account and Aadhaar, primarily unorganized workers, not income tax payers.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension Rs. 1000 to 5000 after age 60 based on contribution, government co-contribution and life cover.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Life insurance scheme offering Rs. 2 lakh coverage for death due to any reason to bank account holders at affordable premium.
eligibility: Bank account holders aged 18-50 years with Aadhaar and auto-debit consent. Coverage till 55 years with annual renewal.
benefits: Life cover Rs. 2 lakh on death due to any reason at annual premium of Rs. 436 via auto-debit from savings account.

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Accident insurance scheme providing coverage for accidental death and disability to bank account holders at minimal premium.
eligibility: Savings bank account holders aged 18-70 years with Aadhaar and auto-debit consent for premium.
benefits: Accidental death cover Rs. 2 lakh and disability cover Rs. 1 lakh at annual premium of Rs. 20 via auto-debit.

title: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Jan Arogya Yojana
description: Maharashtra state health insurance providing cashless quality medical care for identified families for catastrophic illnesses requiring hospitalization.
eligibility: Families holding yellow, orange, Antyodaya and Annapurna ration cards, farmers from distressed districts and general BPL families of Maharashtra.
benefits: Cashless coverage up to Rs. 1.5 lakh per family per year at empaneled hospitals for 1000+ procedures including surgeries and therapies.

title: Pudhumai Penn Scheme
description: Tamil Nadu state scholarship for girl students from government schools pursuing higher education to reduce dropout and promote enrollment.
eligibility: Girl students who studied from Class 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu government schools and pursuing higher education in colleges.
benefits: Monthly assistance Rs. 1000 directly to bank account till completion of degree, diploma, ITI or other recognized course.

title: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
description: Uttar Pradesh state scheme for girl child welfare providing financial assistance in installments for health, education and empowerment.
eligibility: Girl children born after 1 April 2019 in Uttar Pradesh with family annual income below Rs. 3 lakh, maximum two girls per family.
benefits: Total Rs. 15000 in six installments at birth, vaccination, admission to Class 1, 6, 9 and graduation or diploma completion.
